correctness.rationale: The assigned proof is correct. On a convex cyclic quadrilateral all four tangent-line distances and all four side-line distances are affine in the interior point, so the defect is affine. At each vertex the normalized defect is E=x^2+y^2+z^2-sqrt(2)y(x+z), and exact expansion gives 2E=(x-z)^2+(x+z-sqrt(2)y)^2. Nonnegative vertex defects imply the global inequality. Interior equality forces every vertex defect to vanish and cyclically forces all half-arc gaps to pi/4; the square converse is immediate. The inspected exact-ring verifier independently checks the decisive algebraic identity.
